description: This file defines the RRefContext class and related callback functions for managing Remote References (RRefs) in PyTorch's distributed RPC framework. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, and deleting RRefs, handling forks, and managing RRef lifecycle and exceptions.

classes.name: RRefContext
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of Remote References (RRefs), including creation, deletion, forks, and exception handling within the distributed RPC framework.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of RRefContext.

methods.name: destroyInstance
methods.description: Destroys the singleton instance of RRefContext, returning owned RRefs.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Handles exceptions related to JitFuture objects.

methods.name: handleExceptionSilent
methods.description: Handles exceptions silently without throwing.

methods.name: createUserRRef
methods.description: Creates a UserRRef owned by a specified worker.

methods.name: getOrCreateRRef
methods.description: Converts RRefForkData into an RRef, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getOrCreateOwnerRRef
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an OwnerRRef by RRefId.

methods.name: createOwnerRRef
methods.description: Creates an empty OwnerRRef of a specified type.

methods.name: getOwnerRRef
methods.description: Returns a Future for the OwnerRRef, completing when created.

methods.name: addSelfAsFork
methods.description: Adds an OwnerRRef as a fork to the context.

methods.name: addForkOfOwner
methods.description: Registers a fork of an OwnerRRef.

methods.name: addForkOfOwnerIfNotPresent
methods.description: Idempotently registers a fork of an OwnerRRef.

methods.name: delForkOfOwner
methods.description: Deletes a fork of an OwnerRRef.

methods.name: prepareChildFork
methods.description: Prepares RRef data for forking during pickling.

methods.name: notifyOwnerAndParentOfFork
methods.description: Notifies owner and parent about a fork.

methods.name: addPendingChild
methods.description: Adds a pending child RRef.

methods.name: delPendingChild
methods.description: Removes a pending child RRef.

methods.name: addPendingUser
methods.description: Adds a pending UserRRef.

methods.name: delPendingUser
methods.description: Removes a pending UserRRef.

methods.name: addConfirmedUser
methods.description: Confirms a UserRRef.

methods.name: getPendingUser
methods.description: Retrieves a pending UserRRef by fork ID.

methods.name: recordThreadLocalPendingRRefs
methods.description: Starts recording new thread-local pending UserRRefs.

methods.name: waitForThreadLocalPendingRRefs
methods.description: Waits for all thread-local pending UserRRefs to be confirmed.

methods.name: clearRecordedPendingRRefsOnError
methods.description: Clears recorded pending RRefs on error.

methods.name: delUser
methods.description: Deletes a UserRRef.

methods.name: delAllUsersAndUnforkedOwners
methods.description: Deletes all users and unforked owners within a timeout.

methods.name: getDebugInfo
methods.description: Returns debug information as key-value pairs.
